text: Toilet Seat and Cistern Lid replacement completed during a single visit. Prompt and fair pricing. Reliable plumber for smaller but often troublesome works.

name: Jeffery Fontaine
text: Full bathroom rough in for a renovation. Accurate positioning, correct falls and pressure testing. Reliable plumber who works smoothly with other trades. Clean precise work that set the project up well.

name: Justin A
text: We knew there was a water leak somewhere but couldn't locate it ourselves. Grade A Plumbing inspected the plumbing and helped identify perfectly. Instead of guessing, the plumber explained what was being checked and why. Once the source was located, the necessary repair was discussed and completed. It was reassuring to finally understand where the water was coming from.

name: Isabel Eleanor
text: Hydronic heating systems can be difficult to diagnose, so we were relieved to find a plumber with genuine expertise. Grade A Plumbing Craigieburn sent Tim, who took the time to walk us through how the radiant heating system operates while carrying out a thorough inspection.He quickly pinpointed the fault, completed the repair efficiently, and made sure everything was running perfectly before leaving.His friendly manner, technical knowledge, and willingness to explain the process gave us complete confidence.We'd gladly recommend Grade A Plumbing Craigieburn to anyone needing repairs to their radiant heating or hot water system.

name: Mitchell Blumenthal
text: A persistent water hammer issue had us unsure where to start, so getting a proper assessment was the best option.An appointment was arranged for the following day, with Jacob arriving within the two-hour window provided.He took only a few minutes to assess the situation and pointed us towards the appropriate next step rather than recommending unnecessary plumbing work.The honest advice and lack of pressure to pay for a repair we didn't need were genuinely appreciated. A professional, helpful, and straightforward experience.

name: Gabrielle Allain
text: Kitchen drain blockage threatened to ruin dinner for imminent guests. Same day plumber arrived and cleared the blockage first time. Attended promptly and tested the disposal unit for complete client satisfaction. Dinner was served as planned without any further complications.

name: Scott Clark
text: Main line was nearly completely obstructed causing multiple issues throughout the house. The blockage was cleared using a high-pressure washer and the pipe was inspected for any further problems. Effective and timely response resolved a potential plumbing disaster.

name: Robert Smith
text:
Older property with different pipe materials had developing damp area. Careful investigation identified faulty joint location. Repaired with minimal disruption to the property. Highly recommend this plumber for their diagnostic abilities and trustworthy advice.

name: Ronald Massey
text: Flexible hose under sink blew and flooded the cupboard. After hours plumber attended, switched off the water and replaced the hose. Managed the emergency calmly and professionally.

name: Margie Waldron
text: I appreciated that the plumber explained what was causing it rather than simply fixing the symptom. The service was straightforward, professional and much less stressful than dealing with the blockage ourselves.

name: Jimmy Peterson
text: Before the work began, we discussed the expected cost for our plumbing issue service. Grade A Plumbing provided pricing information based on the issue that could be assessed at the property. The plumber then completed the agreed repair and explained what had been done. I appreciated knowing the expected cost beforehand rather than being surprised after the work was finished.

name: Jaxon Honey
text: A simple bathroom tap replacement quickly turned into something much bigger after the old waste pipe behind the vanity crumbled apart. Unsure what to do, we contacted Grade A Plumbing Berwick late in the evening expecting to arrange an emergency visit. Instead, Wyndom took the time to listen to the situation and honestly explained that, because it wasn't causing any active flooding, waiting until the next morning would save us the additional after-hours call-out cost. We really appreciated that level of honesty, especially when it would have been easy to recommend an immediate visit. It's refreshing to find a plumber who genuinely puts the customer's interests first, and that integrity alone has earned our trust for any future plumbing work.

name: Lara Hunt
text: After 15 years of dealing with different plumbers, this service really stood out for both responsiveness and pricing.A kitchen tap suddenly started leaking on a Sunday afternoon and flooded part of the floor, but Jacob arrived within two hours and stopped the leak. Parts needed to be ordered, so he returned two days later to complete the repair.Despite the emergency visit and follow-up appointment, the total cost came to just $250. Fast response, fair pricing, and dependable service exactly what you want when a plumbing problem catches you off guard.

name: James Marshall
text: Routine visit fixed a leaking tap and improved shower pressure in the bathroom. Friendly service with no unnecessary extras pushed. Local plumber who builds trust through consistent honest work over time.

name: Thomas Harwood
text: A dishwasher installation didn't go as planned, so we contacted Grade A Plumbing Bundoora to help sort everything out. What initially looked like a simple drainage issue turned out to be corrosion in the p-trap and connecting pipe that could have easily been overlooked.Jacob carried out a thorough inspection, replaced the damaged plumbing components, and carefully tested the entire system before finishing the job to make sure everything was working perfectly.His attention to detail and professional approach gave us confidence that the problem had been properly resolved,not just temporarily patched. Outstanding workmanship and service from start to finish.

name: Ryan Titheradge
text: Having the gas shut off for safety after a pipe leak made finding the right plumber especially important.After comparing several quotes, the experience and approach gave us confidence that the repair would be handled properly.Ryan and the team managed everything from excavating the driveway and replacing the damaged gas pipes to coordinating the required inspections and taking care of a few smaller plumbing issues along the way. Communication remained clear throughout the project, and everyone involved took genuine pride in the workmanship. The entire repair was handled professionally and efficiently. Highly recommended for complex plumbing work.

name: Ben Leo
text: Amazing team at Grade A Plumber. Bundoora, they helped unblock my toilet and replace a leaking kitchen mixer, I had called them on 9am on a Saturday and they had someone at my home within the hour, I highly recommend the team at Grade A Plumber Bundoora, especially if you are need of a plumber who is cheap and reliable as well as local to the Bundoora are. Thank you very much for your help!!

name: Bryan Taylor
text: They took care of a problem shower valve that another company had tried to fix with no luck. Very helpful and knowledgeable and the job was done right the first time with minimal mess. Very fair price. Will definitely hire them again.

name: Seth McCrae
text: Grade A Plumbing Preston provided fast, professional, and honest service from start to finish. Kyle quickly diagnosed the problem with our toilet cistern and replaced the faulty fill valve without suggesting any unnecessary repairs or extras.The work was completed efficiently, everything was tested before he left, and the whole experience was straightforward. We'd happily recommend Grade A Plumbing Preston to anyone looking for a reliable plumber.

name: Dean Keane
text: Our kitchen sink suddenly stopped draining, so we reached out to Grade A Plumbing Preston and were impressed by how quickly they responded. Josh arrived promptly, diagnosed the blockage straight away, and had the sink flowing normally again in no time. He worked efficiently, kept everything tidy, and explained what had caused the problem before wrapping up. The whole experience was smooth from start to finish, and the quality of workmanship really stood out. We'll definitely be calling them again whenever we need a reliable plumber.
